evidence.paraphrase: Mudgala resumes Brahmā’s creation: Brahmins from mouth, Kṣatriyas arms, Vaiśyas thighs, Śūdras feet; renunciation from head, forest-stage heart, brahmacarya navel and household-state lower legs. Dharma chest and Adharma back set god/demon courses; gods/Gandharvas/Apsarases/Yakṣas/Asuras/Yātudhānas, snakes/birds/beasts/humans arise from his body. They act yet do not multiply. These are source-local cosmological body-emergences, not universal biological descent claims.
